title: REIFE: Re-evaluating Instruction-Following Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the meta-evaluation of instruction-following benchmarks and evaluation protocols for Large Language Models. Although some of the data examples used in the evaluation datasets contain religious or spiritual phrases (e.g., 'Humans are created in the image of God'), these are used solely as linguistic content for testing instruction adherence and are not part of an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
